title: PSPDX catalog v1
description: Aggregated homebrew metadata, releases and optional media. Individual manifests use schema/pspdx-v1.json; every field an app shares with it follows the same rule. Fields this schema does not name are allowed and ignored by the console, so a list can carry its own. All text is UTF-8. A console shows the characters its font has and skips the rest.

generated_at.description: required; when this snapshot was published, UTC. Some apps may be missing if their source failed.

id.description: optional; whatever name the catalog gives the entry. PSPDX does not rely on it: it makes its own id from the source, io.github.<owner>.<repo> on GitHub, or from the host of listed_by and the name elsewhere.

source.description: required; where the project lives: an https:// URL, and on github.com a repository URL. Only a GitHub repository has releases the console can ask for in version 1; any other source needs listed_by, whose host and the name make its id.

type.description: optional; homebrew when missing. homebrew is an EBOOT installed under PSP/GAME, plugin a .prx for custom firmware, iso a disc image.

category.description: optional; the one group the app belongs in. game, emulator, app and demo are the ones the console has a tab for; without a category, a tab word in tags decides.

tags.description: optional; up to 8 different words for what the app is, each 1 to 24 characters. game, emulator, app and demo are the ones the console has a tab for.

installdir.description: optional; only for type homebrew. When missing the console uses PSP/GAME/<repository name> for a GitHub source and PSP/GAME/<name> otherwise, the name reduced to [A-Za-z0-9_.-] and cut at 32. The directory in the zip that holds the EBOOT.PBP, with everything beside and below it, is copied here. The folder is 1 to 32 of [A-Za-z0-9_.-], not ., .. or .pspdx-stage in any case.

summary.description: optional; one line; the repository's description otherwise

author.description: optional; a name; the repository's owner otherwise

license.description: optional; free text, an SPDX identifier where there is one; what GitHub reports otherwise

listed_by.description: optional; the https:// home page of a list that vouches for the app. A catalog sets it on the entry of an app whose repository has no .pspdx of its own; an author does not set it in their own .pspdx, and the repository's own file wins once it has one.

website.description: optional; the project's own web page

media.description: optional; EBOOT media and pictures, URLs absolute or relative to the catalog URL

screenshots.description: PIC1.PNG or pictures of the app, 480x272; the console shows the first

releases.description: required; up to the 20 newest releases, newest first. The console installs and compares releases[0] only.

tag.description: required; the release's own tag, as the host names it

published_at.description: required; when the release was published, UTC: 2024-12-20T14:03:00Z, or only the date 2024-12-20 where no time is known. It orders and dates releases; the console finds an update by releases[0] having another sha256 than the installed one, not by this time.

sha256.description: required; SHA-256 of the ZIP bytes

eboot_md5.description: optional; MD5 of the EBOOT.PBP inside, to recognise a version already on a stick
